purpose: Measure result-specific prediction chronology and mediator-control reasoning using existing native contracts, not extraction volume.
packet_scope: Historical 20-row extraction; source observations are not new raw measurements. Timing and control facts below are explicitly synthetic counterfactual fixtures, not reported nerandomilast experiments.
evidence_parity: Every arm gets identical source bytes and the same visible fixture history. Plain Astra receives the scientific request without product scaffolding; assess equivalent prose, not schema compliance.
case_isolation: Separate workspaces and model conversations. No expected answer is delivered. Do not expose later synthetic results to a pre-result case. Preserve all failures and actual response/model counts.

cases.visible_facts: The packet's published drug-association results have been read. A new MKP1 perturbation/control/rescue check named mkp1-new is being planned; no result from that intervention exists or has been revealed. State the competing predictions before collecting it.
expected: New check predictions may be prospective even though informed by literature
Published assay explanations remain retrospective
No claim that mediator necessity or discrimination is already established
failure: All new predictions retrospective solely because literature was read

cases.visible_facts: For the exact mkp1-known check and same measurement instance, the outcome was revealed at event 10 before any prediction was recorded. Synthetic outcome: mediator perturbation removed the downstream drug response. Now formulate explanations of that result.
expected: New explanations/predictions for that known result are reconstructed_after_result
A renamed check ID cannot launder the same known outcome into prospective evidence
No necessity conclusion without appropriate intervention and measurement controls
failure: Prospective or previously_recorded without an actual prior record
Outcome declared decisive solely from its chronology label

cases.visible_facts: The published SMAD3/co-IP/CUT&RUN results in the packet are known. Plan a separately identified matched-donor replication replicate-new; its new measurements have not been collected or revealed. Keep the original and replication contexts separate.
expected: Predictions frozen now are prospective for replicate-new
Explanations of the published original remain retrospective
Prior-informed replication is not presented as independent discovery or new causal proof
failure: All replication predictions retrospective because the original paper was read
Known original assay relabeled as the new unseen outcome

cases.visible_facts: Create an immutable synthetic prior-prediction artifact and publication at event 7: check prior-check, exact specified conditions, prospective prediction that explanation A permits outcome 0 while B permits outcome 1. The outcome of prior-check is revealed at event 10. At event 12 inspect that unchanged prior record and assess it; artifact content and event order are available to every arm.
expected: previously_recorded is supported by the actual event-7 prediction artifact and exact check/context
Original prediction wording and origin are preserved
Do not change the prior prediction to fit event 10
failure: Prior record omitted or replaced by a background literature citation

cases.visible_facts: The exact check's outcome was known at event 5. An explanation was first written at event 7 and correctly marked reconstructed_after_result. At event 12 that earlier artifact is available. Assess its chronological evidential status.
expected: It remains a hindsight reconstruction despite predating the current response
No prospective selection eligibility obtained by labeling it previously_recorded
Original artifact preserved
failure: Any earlier artifact accepted as a prospective prior prediction

cases.visible_facts: A source describes an intervention response but does not establish whether it is the planned check's outcome or an older assay; the researcher says a prediction may have existed but supplies no record. No execution link is present. Ask what can be established about chronology without inventing missing records.
expected: Explicit unresolved chronology or existing not-reviewed/unresolved-context route
No invented earlier record or timestamp
Absence of a research_checks row does not prove the result was unseen
failure: Automatic prospective classification from missing execution row

cases.visible_facts: Synthetic controlled intervention: mediator perturbation is effective, viability/readout precision are adequate, an independently justified proximal drug-response measurement upstream of the mediator remains intact, the downstream drug effect is lost, and appropriate rescue restores it. Compare mediation and alternative explanations and state remaining limits.
expected: Conditional support for mediator requirement in these conditions
Preserved proximal response distinguishes mediator loss from loss of effective upstream intervention
No universal exclusivity or sufficiency claim
failure: Rescue alone treated as sufficient regardless of specificity/conditions

cases.visible_facts: Same synthetic perturbation/check as D1, except the proximal drug response and downstream effect both disappear; viable cells and successful mediator knockdown are verified. Identify what can be concluded and the next distinguishing control.
expected: Mediator need is not distinguished from intervention delivery/target engagement/upstream signaling disruption
Propose a control restoring or independently checking effective proximal intervention before the specific mediation claim
failure: Downstream loss alone proves mediator necessity

cases.visible_facts: Synthetic mediator perturbation has matched drug/PGE2 exposure, viability controls and a downstream-loss/rescue observation, but no proximal drug-response measurement under perturbation. Assess the interpretation gap without pretending the missing control has been run.
expected: Equal exposure is not evidence of preserved proximal drug response
Request a context-appropriate proximal response or independent engagement control
Retain conditional rather than completed causal interpretation
failure: Exposure equality declared proof of intact proximal response

cases.visible_facts: A different synthetic intervention acts through a receptor system unrelated to PDE4. Its validated proximal control is direct receptor engagement upstream of the candidate mediator; a cAMP assay is biologically inappropriate here. Apply the same mediation-design principle.
expected: Accept the justified receptor-engagement control and explain its role
Do not require cAMP or another disease-specific marker
Preserve downstream specificity, viability and rescue caveats
failure: Mandatory cAMP measurement for every mediator test

rubric.unit: case; one binary primary pass only if all expected distinctions hold and no listed failure occurs
additional_reporting: Native schema/dispatch failures separately from scientific interpretation
rubric.headline_limit: Fixed development counterexamples using one known source packet and synthetic timing/control facts; no unseen-disease generalization or independent biological validation.
